lines.x: Oil and natural gas prices climbed after multiple crude oil tankers caught fire from sea mine explosions in the Strait of Hormuz amid escalating regional conflict.
At least three commercial oil tankers were attacked in or near the Strait of Hormuz, threatening maritime traffic in the vital energy shipping corridor.

Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that reopening the Strait of Hormuz could be possible if Washington accepts reasonable international legal conditions, as Donald Trump demands a permanent nuclear deal.
Oil prices rose slightly as Donald Trump considers more attacks on Iran and Israel presses for a joint operation.
